clauses.clause: Whenever one or more creatures you control attack, they gain indestructible until end of turn.

mapping.notes: The compiler builds the whole tree since ontology round R10 (gate round 10): B2b-attackers-gain-keyword-eot, the 'whenever one or more creatures you control attack' head (DeclareAttackersEvent, once_per_event, CR 508.3d) and GRANT_ABILITY INDESTRUCTIBLE until end of turn over Selector(referent='event'), which under the flag names every attacker the declaration gathered (CR 603.2c, ability_tree.gathers_objects): 'they'. A creature put onto the battlefield attacking was never declared (CR 508.4) and one that changed zones before the ability resolves is a new object (CR 400.7): neither gains it. Closes the needs-atom of 2026-11-05 (no referent selected the declaration's attackers). Packs tools/scenarios/mapped/M20/angelic_guardian_attackers_are_indestructible.json, angelic_guardian_bounced_attacker_is_a_new_object.json and angelic_guardian_attackers_survive_a_wrath.json (Planar Cleansing after the trigger: DESTROY spares an indestructible permanent, CR 702.12b, since main 8db1834f); the CR 508.4 case in MTG_bot/core/test_executor_one_or_more.py.
